C1026.title: Lending Alipay/Bank Accounts Convicted as Aiding Information Network Crimes
C1026.summary: Article 7 of the 2021 Opinions (II) on Telecom Network Fraud Cases lists only acquiring, selling, and renting bank cards and payment accounts as aiding acts for the crime of aiding information network crimes, and does not separately list 'lending.' However, lending personal bank cards or Alipay accounts for use in cybercrime still constitutes the crime under the 2019 SPC/SPC judicial interpretation on aiding information network crimes. Cases of a Qianjiang man convicted for lending an Alipay account and six post-2000 youths in Guangzhou convicted for lending bank accounts to a 'money-running' platform show that such lending carries criminal risk regardless of profit.
